name: Luciela Regal
source:
"Those who defy the [url=/c135513]Archbishop[/url], no matter who they are, I'll kill them."

The partner of  [url=/c135516]Lavi[/url] the Bride, and a teacher at the academy.

She is the leader of the Order of Mages affiliated with the Holy Church, and serves as an assistant to the Archbishop as well. A strict female knight, absolutely loyal to the Archbishop.

Having achieved success on many battlefields, accompanied by her bride, she is regarded as a Hero. The Archbishop has complete trust in her, and she is also known as the "Silver's Left Arm."

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/character_06_luciela.html]official website[/url]]
